sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Claim_Headers"."Policy_ID" AS e, SUM(("Claim_Headers"."Amount_Claimed" - "Claim_Headers"."Amount_Piad")) AS m1 FROM "Claim_Headers" GROUP BY "Claim_Headers"."Policy_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Claim_Headers.amount claimed minus amount paid on claim
why: amount claimed - amount paid on claim: both in USD and of the same kind (flows) on the same one insurance claim
total of amount claimed minus amount paid on claim per Policies (by Policy_ID) (additive)
share of the all total of total of amount claimed minus amount paid on claim (all level)
